rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MEOK MCP Injection Scanner analyzes MCP server descriptions and tool definitions for prompt injection, tool poisoning, RCE patterns, and supply-chain threats using over 30 detection rules across five severity levels. It targets patterns such as system-prompt overrides, credential exfiltration, shell metacharacters, file:// URLs, and encoded payloads, producing signed safety reports. Distributed via PyPI.
